title: A mail client, as the harness measures it
description: clients/<id>.json. See clients/README.md for what each field is for and how to find the coordinates.

source.description: Whether the client's own source is public.

maintainers.description: GitHub handles of whoever keeps this definition right. Empty means nobody yet.

vendor_maintained.description: True when a maintainer works on or for the client itself. Shown next to its results.

bundle_id.description: How the instrument finds the window. Required for launch and quit.

app_name.description: For a client with no bundle of its own (a terminal client): the host app's name.

process.description: Process name, for memory, resizing and quitting.

window_title.description: A substring of the main window's title, when the client has several windows.

version_command.description: Shell that prints the version, for a client without a bundle.

launch_env.description: Environment to launch with. {profile} is the client's benchmark profile directory.

account.description: How to add the benchmark account.

parity.description: Settings that must be changed so the client holds the whole mailbox, as every other client does.

reset.description: How to empty its store, for a first-sync measurement.

store.description: Where it keeps the benchmark account. ~ and globs allowed; {profile} as above.

status.description: verified: checked by snapshot at the version given. unverified: never checked. missing: cannot be measured yet.

row.description: A message row in the list.

row_dy.description: Distance to a second row; clicks alternate between the two.

reader.description: Where the message body paints. Not the whole window.

submit.description: Press Return after the query (for clients that do not search as you type).

clear.description: Steps that empty the field once it has focus, e.g. cmd+a,backspace.

leave.description: One step that leaves the field: a key, or click@x:y.

prepare.description: Replaces click-and-clear before each search, for a field that needs its own sequence.

reset.description: One step that replaces the whole of clearing the search.

metric.description: A key from schema/metrics.json, when the caveat is about one number.

caveats.description: What a reader needs to know to read this client's numbers. Shown next to them.
